title: West Kelowna Wine Tour
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, rain or shine
All wine tour guests are expected to conduct themselves in a respectful manner
Excessive intoxication or use of foul language is not acceptable
Please provide a pick up location when booking. If not listed, selected "my hotel is not listed". Enter hotel name and address.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our West Kelowna wine tour offers an incredible day in Okanagan wine country featuring award winning wineries, beautiful mountain views and a fun day touring and tasting at 5 wineries and vineyards. All our tastings are elevated, offering access to reserve and library wines. Guests will also enjoy a lunch reservation midway through the day (cost of lunch excluded).
